regime_context: The detector shows a broad precious-metals leadership (Gold Miners #1, Silver & Royalties #2) with solid durability bars (0.66/0.63) and high breadth, over a broad but shallow 9-theme eligible set. The rotation is not one-narrative dominant (absorption 0.31), and the validated edge here is the absolute-trend gate for drawdown control — not momentum rank-IC. With a modest 70.9% hit rate but direction accuracy of only 37%, confidence in directional leans is constrained; several scorable non-leader themes are eligible but show weak breadth.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Silver & Royalties width (0.917) and durability bar (0.63) hold near Gold Miners for two more weeks; if the challenger's score closes the 0.173 margin AND holds breadth above 0.8, I would drop the separate precious-metals lean and treat the complex as one co-led theme. If silver breadth drops below 0.7 while gold holds above 0.85, I retire the co-leadership watch.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners lead with the top score (1.8), the highest durability bar (0.66), and breadth of 0.933, which suggests leadership is broad and not a single-name artifact. It remains eligible via the absolute-trend gate, so staying with the trend is consistent with the one validated drawdown-control edge rather than a momentum-call. The lean is a continuation of confirmed leadership, not a prediction.
theses.dissent: Gold runs are mean-reverting after sharp attention spikes; the silver challenger is close (score 1.627) and a commodity-driven theme can reverse fast on a macro rate surprise without any detector warning.
